scope: bounded falsification screen, not formal authorization or virgin confirmation
batch: four records: two exact-source fast/slow pairs in one training House at the same preregistered prefix
invariance_formula: mean squared coordinate distance for two same-source pairs
separation_formula: mean relu(1 - L2 distance)^2 for all four cross-source pairs
feature_schema: measured log1p gas; measured-gas EMA tau1.2 (not sensor state); wind u,v; x/10,y/10; absolute time/60; measurement flag1
candidate_schema: all frozen free-cell XY /10; no candidate pruning; nearest XY cell to physical source is evaluator/training target only
normalization: fixed unit conversions only; no heldout fitted moments
label_permutation: swap two exact-source labels within each training House, consistently across all its prefixes and fast/slow realizations
zs_permutation: swap zS across different sources within the same heldout House and prefix; fixed candidate geometry
uninformative_control: zero measured gas and local wind, retain pose/time; require normalized entropy >=0.95 or abstention
directional_screen: at least two of three Houses have lower NLL and MAP XY error, lower same-source zS distance and same/different distance ratio; different-source separation >=0.9 of unconstrained; context-only, label-permutation, zero and swapped zS must not recover the gain
m2_baseline: conditional first-hit histogram by current measured gas >0.1; fit only train parents; Dirichlet total pseudocount1 uniformly over21 outcomes; compare unconditional train histogram
no_rescue: no additional seeds, steps, thresholds, route horizons, split changes or outcome-driven hyperparameter searches after results
